newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Pembinaan in two Indian power projects.
newsitem.headline: Pembinaan in two Indian power projects.

text.p: Malaysia's Pembinaan YCS Bhd said it was taking equity interest in two Indian power projects and has also won two engineering contracts worth US$240 million linked to the projects.

The first project involved its wholly-owned subsidiary, Inner Review Sdn Bhd, which has entered into an agreement to take up 50 percent equity in Independent Power (Madya Pradesh) Pte Ltd, the company said in a statement received on Monday.
Independent Power has a power purchase agreement with the Madya Pradesh Electricity Board to build, operate and own four 25 megawatt (MW) heavy fuel oil generators.
